prs.title: mods: add the privacy mod
prs.author: poteat
prs.body:
## Summary

> TLDR: Publishes the source of Claude Code's built-in `privacy` mod under `mods/privacy`. No new behaviour.

## Notes

- `mods/privacy`: the hooks module, manifest and README of the built-in that refuses a shell call holding the signed-in account's email address and naming a User-Agent.
- `mods/README.md`: a row for it.
- `mods/types/claude-code.d.ts`: declares `$.session.identity`, which the mod reads.

## Test Plan

- `tsc -p mods/tsconfig.json` passes with TypeScript 5.9.3.
- The mod has no `tests/` folder, so the Mod tests workflow typechecks it and runs nothing for it.
